snippet.title: I Have No Change — Playtest Trailer
snippet.description:
Playtest now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3426150/
Join Discord: https://discord.gg/GDupbvvWzs
About game: https://studiorassvet.com/

Happy May holidays!
I Have no Change playtest is now live.
Immerse yourself in 40 minutes of the life of Matvey Zorenko, a night-shift clerk working in a small town in Far East or Russia.

Music: Не'Мой Фронт — Пропадай 

[Gameplay footage. Captured on PC]
